sideConvention: This model: Yaw=-1 character right turn; Yaw=+1 character left turn. Confirm anew on another model. Pitch=-1 down, +1 up.

usableRegions: jaw and cheek silhouette, nose position, eye plane relationship
excludedRegions: new hair strand detail, changed frills or flower petals, mouth size, tiny highlight details

poseValidation.yawPitch: same quadrant; centers constrained in v2 when first candidate failed
poseValidation.camera: single whole-canvas uniform scaling; no local warp
poseValidation.angleTolerance: qualitative angle match, no inferred degree precision

entries.physics: Historical ledger says disabled; no independent runtime-state proof retained here. Do not use these for numeric motion deltas.
